healthcareSystem: Mixed public-private. Public hospitals are under-resourced. Private clinics in tourist areas and Santo Domingo offer better care.
qualityNotes: Good private hospitals in Santo Domingo and Punta Cana area. Tourist resorts typically have on-site medical clinics. Public hospitals are overcrowded. For serious emergencies, medical evacuation to Miami is common.
pharmacyHours: Pharmacies open 8am-10pm. Chains like Carol, GBC, and Los Hidalgos have extended hours.
pharmacyTips: Pharmacies are well-stocked and affordable. Many medications available without prescription. Pharmacists speak Spanish. Tourist area pharmacies may have English-speaking staff.
prescriptionRules: Many medications available without prescription. Antibiotics often sold OTC. Controlled substances require a prescription.

restrictedMeds.name: Cannabis/CBD products
restrictedMeds.note: Illegal. Possession can result in arrest.

bringDocumentation: Carry a doctor's letter listing medications. Keep medications in original packaging. Spanish translation helpful but not essential in tourist areas.

travelInsurance.tips: Most resorts include basic medical care. For serious emergencies, medical evacuation to Miami costs $15,000-30,000. Ensure coverage includes water sports and adventure activities.

vaccinations.notes: No mandatory vaccinations. Dengue and Zika risk exists — use insect repellent. No malaria risk in tourist areas.

waterNotes: Tap water is NOT safe to drink. Use bottled water. Resorts provide purified water and ice made from purified water. Outside resorts, avoid ice in drinks.
foodSafetyTips: Resort food is safe. Outside resorts, eat at established restaurants. Be cautious with street food, raw seafood from beach vendors, and unpeeled fruits. Dominican cuisine is generally cooked thoroughly.
medicalTourismNote: The Dominican Republic is a growing medical tourism destination, especially for cosmetic surgery and dental work in Santo Domingo.
metaDescription: Complete health & medication guide for the Dominican Republic. Emergency 911, resort medical care, pharmacy tips, dengue prevention, hurricane season health risks, and travel insurance advice.

hospitals.name: Centro Médico UCE (CEDIMAT)
hospitals.notes: Top private hospital. Internationally recognized. English-speaking staff.

hospitals.name: Hospiten Bavaro
hospitals.notes: International hospital chain in the main tourist zone. Handles tourist medical needs.

hospitals.name: Centro Médico Punta Cana
hospitals.notes: Private clinic serving the resort area. 24/7 emergency. English-speaking.

pharmacyPhrases.english: I need medicine for a headache
pharmacyPhrases.local: Necesito medicina para el dolor de cabeza

dentalCare.availability: Good dental care in Santo Domingo at affordable prices.
dentalCare.costRange: $30-60 for consultation; $50-200 for procedures (prices in USD accepted)
dentalCare.notes: Dominican Republic is a dental tourism destination. Quality clinics in Santo Domingo.
dentalCare.emergencyTip: CEDIMAT has dental services. Resort concierges can arrange dental appointments.

mentalHealth.englishTherapists: Limited. Available through private clinics in Santo Domingo and expatriate networks.
mentalHealth.notes: Mental health services limited. Resorts may have access to English-speaking counselors.

accessibilityInfo.overview: Accessibility is limited outside of modern resorts. Colonial zones have cobblestones. Beaches may lack accessible pathways.
accessibilityInfo.transport: No accessible public transport. Resorts may offer accessible facilities. Private transfers recommended.
accessibilityInfo.tips: All-inclusive resorts vary in accessibility — inquire before booking. Zona Colonial in Santo Domingo has uneven surfaces. Some beaches have beach wheelchair rentals.

covidStatus.entryRequirements: No COVID testing or vaccination requirements.
covidStatus.testing: Available at hospitals, clinics, and some resorts.
covidStatus.notes: Dengue fever, sun exposure, and water safety are more relevant health concerns. Hurricane season (June-November) can disrupt medical services.

insuranceClaimProcess: Private hospitals accept credit cards. Resort clinics may bill directly. Keep all receipts. Major hospitals provide English documentation on request.
